Final for Pubiication

TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
3341 S. Prairie Avenue

The Applicant seeks to rezone 3341 South Prairie Avenue from an RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District to a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District in order to legalize the
existing basement unit for a total density of three (3) dwelling units. The subject property is
improved with a two-story, two-flat residential building and provides 0 parking spaces. The
Applicant recently purchased the property in July and seeks to legalize the basement unit to allow
the owner's family members to live in the home. The residential use will remain unchanged, and
no commercial space will be provided.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks the following variation relief to reduce the
required rear setback from 37.09 feet to 35.54 feet, and to reduce the north, south, and combine
side setbacks from 3.4 feet to 0 feet under Section 17-13-1101-B.
